meta.title: Counter offer while bidding is live: the vendor does not answer

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with the existing bids.
Send a counter offer on the vendor's existing bid, changing the counter price to 90.
Verify the buyer grid records that the counter offer was initiated.
Confirm the counter offer remains pending and can be revoked by the buyer.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the live RFQ pricing round where the vendor's bid and pending counter offer are shown.

args.because: You have a counter offer pending on this bid

steps.note: Attempt a vendor price revision and require Procol to refuse it because a counter offer is pending.
Return to the buyer's Responses screen.
Verify on the buyer side that the counter offer is still pending after the vendor does not revise it.
Open Master QCS to inspect the comparison after the pending counter offer.
Confirm Vendor A's comparison rate remains the original 100 rather than the counter price.
